limits: Magic extracts the unchanged accepted GDS, with capacitance/resistance disabled, unique all, no added abstract cells or custom flatten rules. DEF is retained as a required companion input; GDS extraction is selected explicitly.

A versioned fixed launcher changes only Magic.SpiceExtraction.get_script_path to a hash-bound one-line variant of the licensed LibreLane 3.0.16 Tcl: bare extract becomes extract all. The full fresh geometry is extracted, without adding cell abstraction, ignore rules, waivers or changing PDK/tool/worker bytes. The original v1 profile and first execution are retained.

Netgen compares extracted SPICE with the original S11 powered netlist and pinned SKY130 cell SPICE models. The powered file is first hashed at S13, not retrospectively claimed as a hash-retained S11 artifact; its signal graph and component types are checked against the adopted mapped netlist and DEF.

No user LVS ignore/flatten cells or waivers are added. Upstream Netgen uses -blackbox and the pinned PDK setup's device reductions, tolerances and physical-only-cell treatment. These remain part of the recorded comparison scope.
Explicit finite zero error metrics, zero illegal overlaps and a complete top-cell unique-match report are mandatory. Tool exit zero alone is insufficient.
This is recorded layout-versus-powered-netlist connectivity evidence, not formal RTL equivalence, foundry qualification, extracted dynamic simulation, power integrity or dynamic SDF verification.

extraction_variant.reason: The first S13 run demonstrated repeated negative .ext lookups through PDK library paths. Magic 8.3.623 incremental extraction checks timestamps before its visited-definition guard, repeating the lookup per cell use. Full extraction skips this prepass and extracts every fresh cell definition.
